offstage.note: --package= is required, not optional: npx resolves a binary by PACKAGE name, so `npx -y @viraatdas/offstage offstage-mcp` runs the offstage CLI with 'offstage-mcp' as an argument and prints help instead of speaking MCP. Runs the published package, so a plugin install, which clones without building, gets a working server. To drive a local checkout instead, register it under a DISTINCT name so it cannot silently shadow this server: claude mcp add offstage-dev -- node /absolute/path/to/offstage/dist/mcp/index.js
